name: 90035 · Los Angeles, CA
findings: ZIP 90035 (Los Angeles) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 70 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 54 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 90035 (Los Angeles) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
